steps.en: Individual hirer gets an e-reminder referring to the 2nd letter
steps.id: Hirer individu menerima e-reminder yang merujuk surat ke-2
steps.why_en: The e-reminder job is switched off in the production settings, so no reminders go out there.
steps.why_id: Job e-reminder dimatikan di setting production, jadi tidak ada reminder yang terkirim di sana.

steps.en: Hirer who opted out gets no electronic reminder
steps.id: Hirer yang opt out tidak dikirimi reminder elektronik
steps.why_en: Same job as above, switched off in production, so the opt-out check does not run there.
steps.why_id: Job yang sama dengan di atas, mati di production, jadi pengecekan opt out tidak jalan di sana.

steps.en: Hirer with an NRIC due for the 3rd letter is picked for checking
steps.id: Hirer ber-NRIC yang jatuh tempo surat ke-3 dipilih untuk pengecekan

steps.en: Hirer with a FIN or a company is checked via DataHive
steps.id: Hirer ber-FIN atau company dicek lewat DataHive
steps.why_en: The DataHive check job is switched off in the production settings, so it does not run there.
steps.why_id: Job pengecekan DataHive dimatikan di setting production, jadi tidak jalan di sana.

steps.en: Latest address is saved as the hirer's mailing address
steps.id: Alamat terbaru disimpan sebagai alamat surat hirer

steps.en: 3rd letter is made for the hirer and sent to the printer
steps.id: Surat ke-3 dibuat untuk hirer dan dikirim ke percetakan
steps.why_en: Letter is generated, but file upload to the printer is blocked in production, so it is not delivered.
steps.why_id: Letter dibuat, tetapi upload file ke percetakan diblok di production, jadi tidak terkirim.
